_provenance.notes: Emergency orders are issued by ADF&G Area Management Biologists (for commercial fisheries) or Regional Sport Fish Biologists (for sport fisheries) when real-time escapement or run data indicates conservation concerns. Orders may open, close, restrict, or modify scheduled fisheries. The archive goes back to the earliest available online records (approximately 2000). Physical paper archives at ADF&G offices go back further.

notable_emergency_orders.title: Anchor River and Buskin River Closure — Conservation
notable_emergency_orders.description: Closed all salmon fishing in Anchor River (LCI) and Buskin River (Kodiak) for conservation due to critically low escapements. Closure effective through December 31, 2026.

notable_emergency_orders.title: Upper Cook Inlet Kenai River Chinook Emergency Restrictions
notable_emergency_orders.description: Multiple EOs in 2012 season drastically restricted Kenai River late-run Chinook sport and commercial harvest after run fell to crisis levels. BOF subsequently revised management plan.

notable_emergency_orders.title: Bristol Bay Additional Open Periods — Record Run
notable_emergency_orders.description: Multiple additional fishing period EOs issued during July 2022 as record 79.8M sockeye run overwhelmed processing capacity. Some of the longest consecutive fishing periods in BB history.
